title: coverage.mjs fails safely on malformed mode/min/threshold/--stack
goal: Make coverage.mjs exit 2 on malformed runtime configuration instead of silently behaving as if coverage were off.
in_scope: Validate coverage.mode against off|warn|enforce; exit 2 with a message if invalid (including when the raw value is undefined-but-present-as-something-else, e.g. a typo)
Validate coverage.min (when present) is a finite number in [0,1]; exit 2 otherwise
Validate --threshold (when passed) is a finite number in [0,1]; exit 2 otherwise, including non-numeric strings like 'nope'
After stack selection, validate that an explicitly-passed --stack matches a known stack/target id; exit 2 otherwise
out_of_scope: coverage.targets support itself (that is S-3, which builds on this story's guards)
Any change to the coverage.stacks allowlist's existing silent-filter behavior (unchanged, not explicitly required by the spec)
acceptance: An unknown coverage.mode, a non-numeric/out-of-range coverage.min, an invalid --threshold, or an unknown --stack all exit 2 with a clear message; only correctly-spelled off/warn bypass threshold enforcement.
invariants: A typo'd mode must never reach the bottom-of-script 'resolvedMode !== enforce -> exit 0' logic
Existing bare-scaffold / needs_setup / --setup / --story / coverage.command end-to-end tests must keep passing unchanged
